about: Shared synthetic cases for the message gate's rules (cain/rootfs/opt/cain/gate/rules.ts). bun runs them against rules.ts (cain/tests/gate.test.ts) and pytest against the Python port (tests/message_rules.py), so the two stay equal. Made-up words only. Each case: the text, its context (rules: the rules that apply, all when absent; buttons: the labels on the message, null when they can't be told; known: labels on live cards; answers_him: a reply to his own message), the text with the fixes applied (fixed, the text itself when absent), which rules fix, refuse or can't tell, and optionally each hit's excerpt in order (around).
